goals.description: Identify existing plugin entry points, package exports, route refs, API factories, page components, tabbed sub-pages, translations, and validation commands used by the Backstage plugin.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Gather only the context needed to add dual old/new frontend support. Locate existing old-system plugin setup, package.json exports and dependencies, route refs, APIs, page components, tabs/sub-pages, public exports, translations, and project validation commands.
goals.name: Inspect plugin structure

goals.description: Add new-system page component variants that preserve old-system components while removing old page shells from NFS-rendered content and forwarding customization props where applicable.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on component files. Keep existing old-system exports working. Add NFS variants or a headerVariant split so new-system components do not render Page, PageWithHeader, or old ContentHeader shells. Use @backstage/ui Header only for subtitle or custom actions, and forward existing customization props.
goals.name: Create NFS page variants

goals.description: Convert old createPlugin API factories into ApiBlueprint extensions owned by the plugin and make them available to the alpha plugin extensions array.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on API extension files and any API ref definitions. Convert old API factories to ApiBlueprint.make extensions with correct deps and factory behavior. Prefer explicit pluginId ownership on API refs when defining or updating refs, and prepare exports so the alpha plugin can include these extensions.
goals.name: Migrate plugin APIs

goals.description: Reuse existing route refs directly, add defaultTarget values to external route refs where sensible, and account for new-system useRouteRef possibly returning undefined.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on route ref definitions and NFS route usage. Do not add convertLegacyRouteRef or compatWrapper. Add defaultTarget to external route refs for common installed-plugin targets, and ensure NFS code handles undefined links returned by new-system useRouteRef for unbound external routes.
goals.name: Update route refs

goals.description: Create the alpha entry point or alpha directory using createFrontendPlugin, PageBlueprint entries for top-level pages, SubPageBlueprint entries for tabbed pages when applicable, routes, externalRoutes, icon, title, and component re-exports for overrides.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Work on src/alpha.tsx or the src/alpha directory. Define createFrontendPlugin as the default export, wire PageBlueprint and any SubPageBlueprint entries, reuse existing route refs directly, include plugin routes and externalRoutes, choose an appropriate icon, and re-export NFS page variants under adopter-facing names when customization is supported.
goals.name: Define NFS plugin extensions

goals.description: Ensure translation refs, API refs, and route refs remain exported from the main entry point or react package and are not unnecessarily duplicated from the alpha entry point.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Review and adjust public exports. Keep translation refs, API refs, and route refs available from the main entry point or react package for both frontend systems. Avoid duplicating these ref exports from ./alpha unless the skill explicitly requires a component override export.
goals.name: Preserve public refs exports

goals.description: Add the ./alpha subpath export, matching typesVersions entry, and required dependencies for frontend-plugin-api and @backstage/ui when used.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Edit package.json only after knowing the alpha path and imports. Add ./alpha to exports and typesVersions. Add @backstage/frontend-plugin-api and any needed @backstage/ui or icon package dependencies according to actual imports, preserving existing package style.
goals.name: Update package metadata

goals.description: Run type checking, linting, old and new app checks where available, and API report generation when the project uses API reports.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Validate the completed dual-entry implementation. Run the repository's relevant tsc and lint commands, check old and new app integration paths when available, and run build:api-reports if the project uses API reports. Report any commands that are unavailable or fail with concrete details.
goals.name: Validate dual support
